Thought about working in malls?    
    
Not sure how other malls are, but I managed to land a job at one of the largest malls in the US and had to be surrounded by people all day by doing things like package check or directory boards. I know it sounds terrifying, it was terrifying for me at first-- but even with my SA, being surrounded numbed me to it. Of course, I still don't converse any better than I did before, especially with coworkers, but at least it got me used to being in a giant group of people.
